description: Reviews BatteryControl commands that change charging policy, discharge state, or the privileged daemon installation, while keeping read-only status, diagnostics, and help output automatic.
name: BatteryControl command protection
saferAlternatives: Use `batterycontrol status` or `batterycontrol limit status` to inspect charging state before changing a policy.
Keep the discharge floor at 20% unless the battery is deliberately being serviced.
